lines: I would like to know you better.
You have caught my eye. May I stay?
I hoped we might talk again.
There is something about you that draws me here.
I find myself looking for you in the village.
Will you walk with me a little?
I like the sound of your voice.
I am glad our paths crossed today.
I would like another moment of your company.
May I sit beside you for a while?
I came hoping to see you.
I would like us to be more than strangers.
replies: You have my attention. Let us see where this goes.
I am curious about you too. Stay a while.
I am glad you came over. We have time.
There is room beside me. Come and talk.

memoryReplies.family: I am glad you listened about my family. I would like to know you too.
memoryReplies.trait: You have noticed that about me, then. There is more to learn about us both.
memoryReplies.work: You take an interest in my work. That is a welcome start.
memoryReplies.news: You remembered what I told you. I am glad we began talking.

lines: I have been looking forward to seeing you again.
The day feels better when we spend it together.
I keep thinking of our talks.
I am beginning to feel at home beside you.
You are becoming someone I look for every day.
I missed your company since we last spoke.
Shall we find a quiet place together?
I like how easily we talk now.
I want to make more time for you.
I feel happier when you are near.
There is more I want to learn about you.
I would like to be part of your days.
I hope you look forward to these visits too.
I thought of you on my way here.
I am glad we are no longer strangers.
I am growing fond of you.
I like the person I am getting to know.
I wish our visits lasted a little longer.
There is nowhere I would rather sit just now.
I feel I can speak more freely with you.
I saved a little of my day for you.
Could we spend tomorrow together too?
You make this place feel less lonely.
I want us to have more days like this.
replies: I have come to look forward to you too.
It feels easy to have you beside me now.
You have become a welcome part of my days.
I find myself hoping you will come back.

memoryReplies.family: You remember my family. I like that you listen to what matters to me.
memoryReplies.trait: You are getting to know my ways. I am growing fond of yours too.
memoryReplies.work: I like having you to talk to after work. I look forward to it.
memoryReplies.news: You listened, and remembered. I have come to value these talks with you.

lines: I can picture making a life beside you.
I trust you with more than small talk now.
I want you beside me when the days are hard.
You have become dear to me.
I would like our lives to grow together.
When I think of home, I think of you.
replies: You are dear to me. I trust what we have.
I want you in my life, through ordinary days too.
I feel close to you. You can count on that.
I can imagine a home with you in it.

memoryReplies.family: I trust you with my family’s stories. You have become part of my life.
memoryReplies.trait: You know that side of me now. I feel I can be myself with you.
memoryReplies.work: I want you in my life, on working days as well as quiet ones.
memoryReplies.news: I trusted you with that news because you are dear to me.

lines: You know me better than anyone here.
I love the life we are finding together.
I want to keep choosing you, every day.
You have my heart. I hope you know it.
I cannot imagine my days without you now.
Whatever comes, I want to face it with you.
replies: I love you. I want that life with you.
You have my heart too. There is no doubt left.
I feel at home with you as with no one else.
I want to be beside you, whatever comes.

memoryReplies.family: I love that you care for my family’s stories. I want us to make our own.
memoryReplies.trait: You know my ways and still choose me. I love you for that.
memoryReplies.work: I love sharing my days with you, work and all.
memoryReplies.news: I can tell you what weighs on me. I love having you beside me.

public.family: I would like to hear more about {name}.
public.work: I would like to hear about your {trade} work.
public.news: Your news about {name} stayed with me.

social.family: I remember what you told me about {name}.
social.trait: I am growing fond of your {trait} ways.
social.work: I like hearing about your work as a {trade}.
social.news: I remember the news you shared about {name}.

personal.family: Your stories of {name} make me feel closer.
personal.trait: Your {trait} side has become dear to me.
personal.work: I want to share your days, {trade} work and all.
personal.news: I am glad you trusted me with news of {name}.

intimate.family: I want to share your memories of {name}.
intimate.trait: I love you, your {trait} side and all.
intimate.work: I love sharing your days, even the {trade} work.
intimate.news: What happens to {name} matters to me too.

barriers.listener_closeness: I like your company, but I do not know you well enough to promise a life together. Let us spend more time together.
barriers.player_closeness: I feel close to you. I want you to know me just as well before we speak of marriage.
barriers.ill_will: There is still hurt between us. We need to put that right before we think of marriage.
barriers.eligibility: We cannot promise each other marriage while another commitment stands between us.
